items.title: Awesome Datascience
items.content_text:
### Frameworks

*   [Lumen (⭐300)](https://github.com/holoviz/lumen) - Agent framework for chatting with data, turning natural language into SQL, transformation pipelines and visualizations. Outputs are declarative specs that can be inspected, edited, reopened in a notebook or composed into a dashboard.

items.title: Awesome Quant
items.content_text:
### Portfolio Optimization & Risk Analysis

*   [factorlasso (⭐19)](https://github.com/ArturSepp/factorlasso) - `Python` - Sparse multi-asset factor models with cell-level sign constraints, prior-centred shrinkage, and hierarchical clustering group LASSO (HCGL); scikit-learn compatible.

- API: [Thisispaper](https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api-docs)

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes


- API: [Text-till-Kladdesign](https://text-till-klad-design.gracestack.se/api/v1/openapi.json)

  Description: AI fashion design generator — transform Swedish text into clothing concepts

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Cryptocurrency

- API: [BlazePhoenix](https://blazephoenix.xyz/api)

  Description: On-chain DEX aggregator quotes and route execution data

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Commands & Extensions

*   [wiki (⭐67)](https://github.com/plasma-ai/wiki) - Indexed Markdown knowledge bases with a CLI and installable Agent Skill. `wiki install` writes the skill to `~/.agents/skills`, which Gemini CLI discovers.
items.content_html:
